content.text: In Zimbabwe and other countries where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-12|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/how-setting-up-now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-everything-you-need-2|Payment Methods]]s-digital-store-complete-infrastructure-17|setting]] up online stores that can accept crypto payments. This infrastructure gap has left many without a reliable platform to sell their digital products, from ebooks to software. However, with the right combination of free and paid tools, it's possible to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to building a successful digital store lies in its infrastructure. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can create a robust and scalable platform that is not dependent on any single provider. This approach also ensures that you own all your data and have full control over your store, which is essential for building a sustainable business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your products, target audience, and payment processing requirements. You also need to choose the right tools and technologies that align with your business goals and infrastructure needs. For example, if you're looking for a scalable and secure payment processing solution, you may want to consider using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low transaction fee of 0.5%.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your digital store. This involves configuring your payment gateway, setting up your product catalog, and integrating your store with a delivery system. With Stack 01, you can use GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments to create a simple yet effective payment and delivery pipeline. However, if you need more advanced features and scalability, you may want to consider using Stack 02, which includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments.
Use Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments for a scalable digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your store, configuring your payment settings, and making sure that everything is working as expected. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can get your store up and running in just 48 hours, with end-to-end testing and 30-day support to ensure a smooth launch.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use a combination of free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This approach allows you to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% transaction fee.

You can learn more about this solution and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, and get started with building your own digital store today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by setting up your hosting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, set up your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, integrate your payment processing solution, such as NOWPayments. Finally, test your store, configure your payment settings, and go live. With the right infrastructure in place, you can start processing transactions and growing your business.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?
Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments, while Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, offering more advanced features and scalability.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free hosting options that can be used to host a digital product store, with the ability to integrate payment processing and delivery systems.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?
Stack 01 deployment typically takes 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, depending on the complexity of your store and the tools you choose.
What payment processing solution is used in the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low transaction fee of 0.5%.
Do I need to have technical expertise to deploy my digital store?

While technical expertise can be helpful, it's not necessarily required to deploy your digital store. With the right guidance and tools, you can create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
